Seed handling: the seed file is passed to graphify as its repo-relative path. The seed definition is passed as graphify's own node id, looked up in graph.json by file and first line (rules: line+name, then name-in-range, then line). graphify's path::Name form does not resolve class members written Owner.member.

Every graphify call is the shipped CLI (affected, query, explain) run as a subprocess. The adapter reads the printed NODE, affected and connection lines in graphify's own order and maps each one to its graph.json node, and from there to the repository file and, where a line is given, the definition. The resulting ranked file list goes unchanged to the shared harness: mapSeed, then answer() with file granularity, signature form, no padding and budgets of 2,000, 4,000, 8,000 and 16,000 tokens. Short lists are not padded. Records also carry config_name, as sweep.js writes it.

The 10 configurations, written before any run: affected; affected-d4; query-text (the native defaults); query-text-full (--budget 100000); query-text-full-d3; query-seed (--seed <def> --seed <path>); query-seed-full-d3; query-seed-dfs-full-d3; explain-all (--all on the definition, then on the file); affected+query-seed-full-d3 (union in that order).

Complexity for graphify is 1 for the base command, plus 1 each for a non-default --depth, a non-default budget (--budget, or explain --all, which lifts explain's default cap of 20 connections), --dfs, and a union of two different graphify commands. Two choices of reading: the same command run on the definition and on its file counts as the task's one seed, not a union; --seed is the input of query, not an option, and adds nothing. The resulting counts are affected 1, affected-d4 2, query-text 1, query-text-full 2, query-text-full-d3 3, query-seed 1, query-seed-full-d3 3, query-seed-dfs-full-d3 4, explain-all 2, affected+query-seed-full-d3 4.

The best T1 tuning primary is affected+query-seed-full-d3 at 0.6880 (standard error 0.0304), so the threshold is 0.6576. Three configurations are eligible: affected+query-seed-full-d3 (complexity 4, 0.6880), query-seed-full-d3 (complexity 3, 0.6816) and query-text-full-d3 (complexity 3, 0.6709). Median tokens (7,999 for both) and name were not needed.

Its T1 primary of 0.6816 is 0.104 recall below the typed primary (0.7853), 0.078 below scripted search (0.7593), 0.071 below the changed-together floor (0.7521) and 0.038 below the same-folder floor (0.7191). Graphify's default answers are short by design. The default query (query-text) is cut by graphify's own budget near 2,300 tokens (median) and scores 0.390 on T1.
